before.relationship: Narrative setting: David receives a country town while away from Saul
before.rationale: Chronicles introduces helpers joining David at Soklag while he was kept from Saul; Samuel narrates Achish granting David the country town Ziklag. Each passage’s place form is retained.

after.relationship: Narrative setting: David’s separation from Saul
after.rationale: Chronicles places the helpers’ arrival during David’s separation from Saul. Samuel narrates David deciding to escape Saul, moving with his men into the foreigners’ land, and Saul ceasing pursuit; it supplies the earlier setting without identifying the later helpers individually.

changes.reason: Target alone omitted Saul and could depend on unresolved Soklag/Ziklag identification. Replacement targets the explicit David–Saul narrative setting and avoids that equation.
